about: UT1's web categories: the blacklists of Universite Toulouse 1 Capitole, under the Creative Commons licence CC BY-SA 4.0, fetched by the firewall itself; this project republishes none of them. A category's names are the DNS names of its domains file, counted on the day below; its bare IPv4 lines are left out, as DNS cannot use them. The labels and descriptions are this project's own words, each a string the page translates: a description is one short sentence, or none where it would only repeat the label. Where approximate is true the count is not this project's: UT1's own page of 2026-10-08.
